'''Mireia Gutiérrez Cabanes'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Gutiérrez|Cabanes}} (born 9 October 1988) is an [[Andorra]]n female  former [[skier]]. She represented [[Andorra]] in the [[2010 Winter Olympics]], in the [[Alpine skiing|Alpine skiing events]].<ref name="vancouver2010">{{cite web |url=http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-alpine-skiing/athletes/mireia-gutierrez_ath1000402rJ.html |title=Mireia Gutiérrez, Alpine Skiing |website=Vancouver2010.com |publisher=[[Vancouver Organizing Committee for the 2010 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games]] |accessdate=12 March 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100312084650/http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-alpine-skiing/athletes/mireia-gutierrez_ath1000402rJ.html |archive-date=2010-03-12}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Mireia Gutiérrez |quote=Full name: Mireia Gutiérrez Cabanes}}</ref> She also took part in the [[FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2009]].
